1 Bean = 1 Guardian Point
The validity period of the guardian points is 7 days. You can send gifts to your guardian voicer to increase your guardian points. The guardian points will be deducted at 00:00:00 (GMT+0) on the 8th day after it is obtained.

1. In the VOICE room, send gifts worth 2,500 beans to a voicer within a single day(00:00:00 - 24:00:00, GMT+0), you will become his guardian. 
2. The TOP 1 guardian and the voicer become a couple. 
3. Each voicer can have multiple guardians, and each user can also guard multiple voicers. 
(The data may be a 1-2 minutes delay in updating.)
